head.t: New evidence hub offers a single source for data and research
head.x: We are pleased to introduce our new RNID evidence hub, bringing together research, data, and insights from people with lived experience in a single resource. It's the first evidence hub dedicated to providing in-depth evidence and research about people who are deaf, have hearing loss or tinnitus.

head.t: PRISM: incorporating advanced imaging technologies into a comprehensive strategy for hard-to-heal wound assessment and management
head.x: Head-to-heal wounds—particularly diabetic lower-extremity wounds—remain among the most challenging and resource-intensive problems in contemporary healthcare, with five-year recurrence rates of 40–65% and a trajectory toward amputation that is frequently driven by three interacting and often under-recognised failures…

head.t: An online learning resource in support of the recruitment of people living with dementia and their carers to research
head.x: Although the number of people diagnosed with dementia is increasing globally, it is estimated that only 2% are engaged in dementia research in the UK. In part, this may be due to a lack of confidence on the part of health and social care professionals to discuss research opportunities.

head.t: Continuous intravenous acyclovir during OPAT – Full Text
head.x: "The acyclovir OPAT programme led to cost savings of 3486 EUR per patient.
